title: Red-first names detached processes instead of 'other'
body: Outcome: when the red-first sandbox wrapper kills orphaned processes and forces exit 125 ('detached check processes remained', src/verdict/sandbox.ts ~:967-981), krn verify prints red-first FAIL with cause 'detached processes remained' instead of the opaque 'head=other', and the diagnostic tail is kept under the lead run dir. Evidence: PR #194 observer left a detached worker driver; head classified 'other' and the diagnostic was deleted (src/flow/repository.ts:697-710); a subagent needed ~2 min to reproduce it (/mnt/storage/tmp/krn/redfirst-diag/verdict.md). Proof: new observer under test/flow/ red at base by assertion.
